title: Technical Writer
company: FLYWORLD's OVERSEAS EDUCATION SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED
description:
**Job Description:**

We are seeking talented Engineers with a strong aptitude for technical content write and review to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will possess a solid technical background and exceptional English language proficiency.

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and technically proficient Technical Writer to prepare, review, and edit technical documents for clients pursuing professional skills assessments and related services. The candidate will be responsible for developing clear, accurate, well-structured, and professionally presented technical documentation based on clients’ qualifications, project experience, and relevant supporting information.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare and develop technical reports, professional documentation, project descriptions, and other technical documents based on client requirements.
* Review clients’ academic qualifications, employment history, project details, and supporting documents to ensure accuracy and consistency.
* Gather relevant technical information from clients through discussions, questionnaires, and document reviews.
* Translate complex technical information into clear, structured, and professional written content.
* Ensure that all documents meet applicable assessment guidelines, submission requirements, and internal quality standards.
* Edit and proofread documents for technical accuracy, grammar, spelling, formatting, and consistency.
* Coordinate with clients to obtain missing information, clarify technical details, and complete documentation within the required timelines.
* Conduct research on relevant technical concepts, industry standards, and assessment requirements when necessary.
* Maintain proper records of client documents, revisions, and case progress.
* Manage multiple assignments simultaneously while ensuring timely delivery and high-quality output.
* Collaborate with processing teams, team leaders, and other departments to ensure smooth case progression.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of client information and organisational records.
* Stay updated on relevant industry practices, documentation standards, and applicable assessment guidelines.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technical Communication, English, or a relevant discipline is preferred.
* Previous experience in technical writing, report preparation, documentation, or skills assessment processing is an advantage.
* Excellent written English, editing, proofreading, and communication skills.
* Strong research, analytical, and information-gathering abilities.
* Ability to understand technical concepts and present information in a clear, logical, and professional manner.
* Good attention to detail and commitment to maintaining documentation accuracy.
* Proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel, and other relevant documentation tools.
* Strong organisational and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet strict deadlines.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Quality, accuracy, and completeness of technical documents.
* Number of documents completed within the assigned turnaround time.
* Adherence to applicable documentation and assessment guidelines.
* Reduction in errors, revisions, and rework.
* Client satisfaction and effectiveness of client communication.
* Productivity and timely completion of assigned cases.
* Compliance with internal quality standards and confidentiality requirements.

Desired Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be proactive, detail-oriented, technically competent, and committed to producing high-quality documentation. They should possess excellent written communication skills, a structured approach to report preparation, and the ability to understand client requirements and convert technical information into accurate, professional documents.

**Professional Integrity:** All technical documents must be prepared using genuine client information, verified project details, and accurate representations of the client’s qualifications and experience. Fabrication or misrepresentation of information is strictly prohibited.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹23,000.00 per month

Experience:

* total work: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Head of ERP Product Design & Functional Architecture
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**A. ERP Product Strategy & Functional Design**

* Own the functional design and product experience of complex ERP systems and interconnected enterprise applications.
* Translate business objectives, customer requirements, and operational challenges into scalable ERP functionality.
* Define product modules, features, user journeys, business rules, workflows, and system behavior.
* Ensure all modules work together as one cohesive product rather than disconnected features.
* Identify functional gaps, redundant processes, and inefficiencies; propose simplifications.
* Challenge unclear, conflicting, or unnecessary requirements and propose better solutions.
* Balance business value, customer needs, usability, technical feasibility, scalability, and timelines in design decisions.
* Maintain consistency in business logic, terminology, functionality, and user experience across the platform.

**B. ERP Functional Architecture & Cross-Module Integration**

* Design and structure multi-module ERP platforms covering departments, user roles, business processes, and workflows.
* Translate finance, accounting, procurement, sales, inventory, HR, project management, operations, and customer management processes into software functionality.
* Define module relationships and dependencies, including shared entities, data dependencies, transaction flows, approvals, permissions, and business rules.
* Define master data relationships, transaction lifecycles, status transitions, validations, and cross-module interactions.
* Ensure transactions in one module trigger the appropriate updates, actions, and workflows in other modules.
* Account for multi-company structures, multiple branches, role-based permissions, configurable business rules, and audit requirements.
* Identify architectural and functional gaps before they become development or implementation problems.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Solution Architecture to ensure designs are feasible, scalable, and maintainable.

**C. End-to-End Workflow & Business Process Design**

* Analyze existing business processes and design optimized future-state workflows.
* Create workflows covering user actions, system responses, business rules, decision points, approvals, validations, and outcomes.
* Design approval hierarchies, notifications, escalations, task assignments, automated actions, and exception handling.
* Map process ownership and handoffs between departments, users, modules, and external systems.
* Define alternate flows, failure scenarios, reversals, cancellations, retries, and exceptional conditions.
* Produce process diagrams, flowcharts, swimlane, state-transition, and sequence diagrams where appropriate.
* Ensure workflows are logically complete, operationally practical, and minimize manual work, duplication, and bottlenecks.

**D. API Requirements & System Integrations**

* Define functional API requirements and integration specifications in collaboration with Engineering.
* Define API operations, request/response structures, input requirements, business validations, and expected outcomes.
* Document integration triggers, data mappings, dependencies, authentication requirements, and error-handling expectations.
* Define expected behavior for failed requests, duplicate transactions, missing data, timeouts, retries, and synchronization issues.
* Map data and information flows between internal modules and third-party platforms.
* Assess integration feasibility, dependencies, security implications, and implementation complexity with Engineering.
* Review API and integration documentation for alignment with approved functional requirements. (Direct backend coding is not mandatory.)

**E. UI/UX Design Leadership**

* Lead UI/UX Designers responsible for ERP interfaces, user journeys, interaction design, and visual consistency.
* Guide information architecture, navigation, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.
* Establish reusable design systems, components, patterns, and product-wide UX standards.
* Review and approve designs before engineering handoff.
* Ensure designs cover all interface states: loading, empty, success, error, validation, access restrictions, and exceptions.
* Balance usability with the data density and operational complexity typical of ERP applications.
* Encourage user research, usability testing, and customer feedback; measure design quality by functional effectiveness and usability.

**F. Business Analysis & Requirements Management**

* Lead the BA function and set standards for requirements gathering, analysis, and specification.
* Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, and business rules.
* Ensure requirements cover normal flows, alternate scenarios, exceptions, dependencies, permissions, and edge cases.
* Identify contradictions, ambiguities, missing requirements, and scope gaps before development begins.
* Maintain traceability between business objectives, requirements, workflows, designs, API specifications, and test scenarios.
* Review and approve functional specifications before development handoff.

**G. Technical Documentation & Product Specifications**

* Lead the Technical Documentation Writer and set documentation standards.
* Ensure preparation and maintenance of PRDs, functional specifications, API specifications, process documentation, and user guides.
* Maintain a single source of truth for approved product functionality and functional decisions.
* Ensure consistency between requirements, process diagrams, interface designs, API specifications, and implementation details.
* Review and approve documentation before sharing with Engineering, QA, Implementation, Support, or clients.
* Keep documentation current as product functionality evolves.

**H. Client Communication & Requirements Discovery**

* Act as a primary product-facing contact for clients on business requirements, ERP functionality, workflows, and functional design.
* Lead client meetings, requirements-gathering sessions, discovery workshops, and design walkthroughs.
* Ask structured questions to identify the actual business problem behind each requested feature.
* Demonstrate workflows, wireframes, prototypes, or functional concepts to clients.
* Professionally challenge unclear, conflicting, or unnecessarily complex client requests.
* Manage client expectations on functionality, dependencies, limitations, timelines, and scope.
* Maintain records of meeting outcomes, approved requirements, functional decisions, open questions, and change requests.
* Obtain appropriate approvals and manage clarifications through development handoff.

**I. Core Product vs. Client-Specific Customization Decisions**

* Evaluate every client requirement and classify it as core product, configurable, integration-based, client-specific customization, deferred, or rejected (see Section 5).
* Assess business value, strategic alignment, relevance to the broader customer base, effort, feasibility, scalability, maintenance cost, and commercial implications.
* Identify recurring client requirements that could become reusable features.
* Assess the impact of changes on existing modules, business rules, data structures, APIs, workflows, permissions, reporting, and other customers.
* Establish clear boundaries between standard product functionality and client-specific deliverables.
* Document the rationale for major decisions and communicate outcomes to clients and internal teams.
* Ensure customizations do not compromise maintainability, scalability, upgradeability, or consistency of the core product.

**J. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Define clear roles, responsibilities, deliverables, quality standards, and performance expectations for the team.
* Allocate work based on business priorities, dependencies, complexity, and capacity.
* Establish a structured process from client discovery through requirements, functional design, UI/UX, documentation, handoff, and validation.
* Review deliverables across disciplines for consistency between workflows, specifications, designs, and documentation.
* Resolve functional disagreements, remove blockers, and make timely decisions.
* Coach team members and build a culture of accountability, analytical thinking, and end-to-end ownership.
* Coordinate with Product Management, Engineering, QA, Implementation, Sales, and business stakeholders.

**K. Decision-Making & Problem-Solving**

* Take ownership of product design and functional decisions without requiring constant senior management intervention.
* Break down complex, ambiguous business problems into structured, actionable solutions.
* Evaluate alternatives on business impact, customer value, feasibility, risk, complexity, and maintainability.
* Resolve conflicts between modules, workflows, stakeholders, and business rules.
* Identify risks early and recommend corrective actions.
* Escalate strategic, contractual, financial, or high-impact decisions outside the role’s authority.

**Experience Required:**

7–10+ years in ERP / enterprise software product design, functional architecture, or business systems analysis; minimum 2–3 years leading multidisciplinary teams or owning significant product design initiatives

Pay: ₹150,000.00 - ₹200,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
